Services

Website
development.

We build fast, clear websites and online shops for companies, sole traders and associations. We do everything ourselves, from design to launch, so you talk directly to the people building your site.

Request a quote Book a consultation

What you get

  • Design that fits you

    The look follows your logo, colours and style, and the structure is built around what your customers are looking for.

  • Mobile-friendly

    The site looks and works just as well on a phone, a tablet and a desktop.

  • Fast loading

    Optimised images and clean code, because slow sites lose visitors and rank lower on Google.

  • Ready for Google

    Titles, descriptions, a sitemap and a Google Search Console setup, so customers can find you.

  • Enquiries and bookings

    A contact form that sends enquiries straight to your inbox and, if you like, appointment booking through a calendar.

  • Privacy and cookies

    A cookie notice, analytics that only start once visitors agree, and help with your privacy policy.

  • Several languages

    If you do business abroad, the site can have several languages, each on its own address that Google shows separately.

  • Online shop

    Product catalogue, basket, online card payments and delivery integration, for example to parcel lockers.

Prices and timelines

Service Price Typical timeline
Business website from €1,000 2–4 weeks
Online shop from €2,000 4–8 weeks
Website maintenance updates, backups and support from €50 / month monthly

Prices are final: we are not registered for VAT. You receive the exact price and timeline in a written offer after a short conversation. All services and prices are listed in our price list.

What does the price depend on?

  • the number of pages and the amount of content,
  • whether we design from scratch or build on your existing visual identity,
  • special features such as bookings, several languages or connections to other systems,
  • for an online shop, also the number of products and the payment and delivery options.

We explain this in more detail in How much does a website cost in 2026?

  1. 01

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to prepare the texts and photos myself?

It is best if you provide the content about your business, because nobody knows it better than you. We help with the site structure, editing the texts and choosing photos, and on request we also design a logo and visual identity.

Who owns the website and the domain?

You do. The domain and hosting are registered in your name, and once you have paid the agreed price, all rights to the code and design created for your project pass to you.

What if I find a bug after launch?

We fix bugs reported within 3 months of handover free of charge. After that you can take out maintenance from €50 per month, with 30 days' notice.

How does payment work?

Unless the offer says otherwise, you pay 50 % in advance and the rest on delivery. All conditions are set out in our terms and conditions.
